locations.description: Optional list of Workday location UUIDs (the facet values shown in the Workday location filter). Values from the facets response: facets[].values[].id.
locations.title: Location Facet IDs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

postedAt.description: Optional cutoff. Accepts an ISO date (2026-04-01) or a relative string like '7 days' / '30 days'. Jobs posted before the cutoff are skipped when startDate or postedOn can be parsed.
postedAt.title: Posted At Cutoff

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy (datacenter is enough — Workday's public API accepts datacenter IPs cleanly).
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each job's detail endpoint for the full HTML description, timeType, country, canApply, etc. Turn off for listing-only, faster runs.
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape Job Details

searchText.description: Optional full-text keyword filter passed as searchText on the Workday API (e.g. 'engineer', 'marketing').
searchText.title: Search Keyword

startAt.description: Optional ISO date (2026-05-01) or relative '14 days'. Skips jobs whose startDate is before the cutoff.
startAt.title: Start Date Cutoff

startUrls.description: Public Workday careers-site URLs to scrape. Accepts tenant career pages (e.g. https://salesforce.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site) or direct job URLs that contain /job/...
startUrls.title: Workday Careers URLs
